subject: Spelling 4 (#2241)
reason: The change (Spelling 4, #2241) only fixes typos in comments across allocator_defrag.c, hyperloglog.c, lolwut5.c, rdb.c and sparkline.c, and renames a local variable binind to bin_index in allocatorShouldDefrag with identical expressions and control flow.
